\T\L\S\K\AGong volume\L\B\K\N
The displayed gong volume is assigned to the vehicle key from display zone 1. This assignment is stored in the ACC control unit. If the setting is changed on the MMI, the new information is stored in the ACC control unit.\L\S\K\N

\T\L\S\K\ADistance basic setting\L\B\K\N
The distance basic setting is fixed in the ACC control unit at 3. The setting on the MMI can be changed for a driving cycle. After ignition off/on the distance basic setting is reset to 3.\L\S\K\N
